plugin.name: PixelLab
plugin.description: Create pixel art, characters and animations with your PixelLab account.
plugin.longDescription: Pixen pixel art, eight-direction characters and skeleton animations from PixelLab, in the Image node. Characters and animations come back as PixelLab's GIF. Skeleton animation needs one character reference image. Paid jobs resume after a restart; stop ends local waiting, and PixelLab may still finish and charge for the job.
config.apiKey.title: PixelLab API key
